name: Does replacing the track also mean replacing the sliding door rollers?

mainEntity.name: Does replacing the track also mean replacing the sliding door rollers?

acceptedAnswer.text: While not always mandatory, it is highly recommended to replace the sliding door rollers when replacing the track. Worn or damaged rollers are a common cause of track damage in the first place, and new rollers ensure optimal performance with the new track. Installing new rollers simultaneously can significantly extend the lifespan of your new track and provide a smoother, quieter operation. It's a good practice to address both components for a comprehensive solution.
acceptedAnswer.description: It is highly recommended to replace sliding door rollers when replacing the track, as worn rollers often cause track damage and new rollers ensure optimal performance and extend the new track's lifespan.
